messages:
elena: Heads-up — after the RBAC role rename last night, a handful of customers see SCIM "422 Unprocessable Entity" during provisioning. Error looks like claim mismatch + KMS unwrap failure for some system teams. Repro steps attached.

 darin: which customers? logs? :mag: 

 elena: customer ids cc: @marta: cust-78, cust-104, cust-210. Example error from scim-worker:
 ```
 2026-03-19T23:41:02Z ERROR scim: provisioning failed {"status":422, "detail":"invalid externalId: expected string, got null", "kms_error":"DecryptFailed"}
 ```

 marta: ok checking KMS metrics and key rotation. Not seeing recent rotate events. Could be policy change. Will check key alias permissions.

 samir: also seeing some SAML assertion noise — Identity team changed NameID format mapping and AuthnContext got stripped for a subset. Might explain externalId missing when JIT provisioning expects email/nameid.

 elena: yes, we saw mismatch between incoming SAML NameID and SCIM externalId mapping. We rolled RBAC change 02:15 UTC but the provisioning pipeline still uses cached mapping on dedupe service.

 ryan: quick triage plan:
 - put SCIM sync in probe/dry-run mode for affected orgs: `scimctl sync --org cust-78 --probe`
 - enable verbose audit for scim-worker: env DEBUG=scim:worker npm run start
 - run KMS decrypt dry-run: `kmsctl decrypt --key alias/redwood-provision --ciphertext <sample>` (do not share ciphertext publicly)

 ops-bot: deploy job 1723 started by @darin: bump scim-worker log level.

 marta: KMS audit shows 2026-03-19T23:40 UTC an IAM policy update for role `scim-decryptor` that removed `kms:Decrypt` for a service principal. Rolling back policy now.

 darin: before rollback, can we confirm affected tokens? List shows 3 keys with failed attempts. policy rollback underway — ETA 6m.

 elena: also re: claim normalization, our mapping service drops empty strings. If NameID is empty string instead of null, it becomes '', causing validation fail `externalId: expected non-empty`. Need a fix to treat '' as null.

 samir: quick patch suggestion in mapping service:
 ```
 if (value === '') value = null;
 ```
 but we should normalize upstream in SAML adapter instead.

 marta: rollback done. KMS decrypt failures stopped for cust-78. SCIM sync probe run shows 0 changes (dry-run) but same validation warning for cust-104.

 ryan: for cust-104 logs show SAML assertion with:
 ```
 <NameID Format="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:unspecified"></NameID>
 <AuthnContextClassRef></AuthnContextClassRef>
 ```
 empty elements. That triggers mapping -> ''.

 elena: agreed. Short-term: update scim-worker to treat empty string as null and re-run provisioning in probe. Long-term: request IdP team to enforce non-empty NameID or send email in attribute.

 samir: opened a ticket to idp-configs repo: https://git.internal/redwood/idp-configs/issues/122 — requesting mapping change + audition.

 darin: can we also add an alert on "KMS DecryptFailed rate > 5/min" and "SCIM validation error spikes"? ops create a pager? :bell: 

 ops-bot: alert rule created: scim.validation.spike (threshold 10/min) and kms.decrypt.fail.rate (threshold 5/min).

 marta: will follow up with customers; cust-210 prefers us to pause automatic provisioning until we confirm fix.

 elena: set provisioning paused for cust-210, cust-104. Will re-run probe for cust-78 once patch rolled.

 samir: small note — remember to update audit log entries so we can link RBAC policy change id in the ticket. I added policy id "pol-7892" to the incident notes.

 elena: thanks everyone. I'll push the scim-worker patch, coordinate canary, and post results.
